**Issue #1651 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1651: Patch: the economy's glow-up — Jlore always shown, filling bars, physical packs, per-card cosmetics in context, Epic+ global cosmetics
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

The owner's brief for a visual glow-up of the economy, plus two cosmetic-model changes. It is a tracker: queued as `bot:fullsend`, so the first run splits it into parts that land on `bot/issue-<n>` and one reconcile opens the pull request. Each part writes the rulings it needs from this issue's block (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers) and edits `spec/14-economy.md` where it changes what §14 says. Wherever a line below disagrees with a ruling today, this issue is the owner's new call: supersede that ruling in a new note, don't keep the old behaviour.

## What it does

### 1. Jlore always on screen (owner: "Jlore is the Primo currency")
- A small Jlore pill (icon + balance from `GET /api/wallet`) sits in the top bar next to the language and settings buttons (`apps/web/src/routes/nav.tsx`, `SettingsButton`), on every screen of a signed-in person that shows the top bar. Not on the board (the board supplies settings itself), not for a signed-out visitor.
- It updates when the wallet changes (a pack bought, a game paid, a quest or a track level paid) without a reload, counting up/down to the new value, and clicking it opens `/shop`.
- The server still owns the balance (CLAUDE.md rule 7): the pill renders the wallet answer, never a client sum.

### 2. Pity and odds go out of the way
- Today the Shop screen shows pity counters as `n / threshold packs` and an odds table on the pack panel (`apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`, `PackPity`, `PackOdds`; `shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`'s odds; R1339000, R1580000, §14.4's "the pack screen adds a line that pity guarantees…").
- Move both off the Shop and pack screens onto a **Purchases disclaimer** page (a new static page, e.g. `/purchases`, linked from the site footer `routes/SiteFooter.tsx` beside Terms and Privacy, and from one small "Odds & pity" text link at the bottom of `/shop`). It shows the server's odds percentages (unchanged source: `GET /api/packs` and the cosmetic packs answer) and the account's pity counters, plainly.
- The odds stay published and server-computed (§14.4 still holds that the client never computes a rate); only *where* changes. Edit §14.4 and supersede R1339000/R1580000's placement wording.

### 3. Token bars fill up, rewards feel punchy
- The card token bar and cosmetic token bar (`shop/TokenPicker.tsx`, today `Card token bar: 7 / 20` as text) become real bars that fill. On the pack-opening scene, when spent duplicates add points, the bar animates from the old fill to the new one, and when it fills it bursts, pays (the token, or the next `COSMETIC_TOKEN_CYCLE` step) and visibly restarts with the overflow.
- A filled bar's reward gets its own reveal moment (the token or cosmetic pack flying out), not a line of text. The Chase Shard bar gets the same treatment.
- The numbers may stay as small secondary text; the bar is the primary read.

### 4. XP tracks fill the same way, every time XP lands
- Set track bars (`collection/TracksPanel.tsx`, a bare `<progress>`) get the same bar style as §3.
- Whenever XP is gained — after a ladder, unranked, Conquest or co-op game, after a paid practice game (`routes/practice.tsx`'s `paid` answer with `xp`), after a quest completes (`routes/QuestsPanel.tsx`) — the player sees the active track's bar fill from before to after. A level reached is a big moment: the bar bursts, the level number pops, and the level's rewards (cards, Jlore, packs, from the server's answer) are revealed one by one with sound and a flourish. Several levels at once chain.
- If the end-of-game answer lacks the before/after track state the client needs to animate this, add it to the server's answer (it already knows; the client must not compute the curve).

### 5. Pack purchasing: packs as physical objects
- Each pack kind in the store (`shop/Shop.tsx`, one per shipped set plus the global pack, and the cosmetic pack) is drawn as a physical, collectible-looking pack, Hearthstone-style: foil wrapper with a crimped top/bottom seal, the set's emblem and colours, a sheen that tracks the pointer, a slight 3D tilt on hover, a satisfying press on buy, and the bought pack flying into the inventory count.
- The pack-opening scene uses the same pack object (tear/burst open), so buying and opening read as one thing.
- Reduced motion holds every animation still (the settings' Reduce motion and the media query, as `cards/cosmetics.css` does); every animation is transform/opacity only.

### 6. Cosmetics shown in context, per card
Today the three card cosmetics are one global pick each (`collection/CosmeticsPanel.tsx`'s `CardCosmeticsControls`, `cards/cosmetics.ts`: one foil, finish and border for all your cards, "every one unlocked"), and the Collection lists owned cosmetics as text (`OwnedCosmetics`: `Holo sweep · Foil · Rare · On Big D`).
- **Per-card equip.** Foil, finish, border and full-art face are equipped per card, for cards the account owns the cosmetic on (§14.2 already says a per-card cosmetic is owned for one card). The store grows a per-card map beside the account defaults (keep the `cosmetics` settings group's shape compatible: an old client must not overwrite a new one's picks, as `normalizeCosmetics` keeps unknown ids today). Practice, hotseat and the e2e fixtures still treat every cosmetic as owned (R1310004).
- **In context in the Collection.** Clicking a card in the Collection opens it large, wearing its equipped cosmetics, with a strip of the cosmetics it owns for that card drawn as live previews on the card itself (hover a foil, the card shows that foil). Account cosmetics (playmat, backdrop, card back) preview as a mini board / a card back, not a select list. Unowned ones may show locked and greyed with their rarity, so a player can see what exists.
- **Hover/preview keeps them.** A card's own cosmetics must also show on the inspect/hover preview (`cards/inspect/`) and anywhere the viewer's own card is enlarged, not only on the board face (`game/wearer.ts` today gates them to the board's own cards). An opponent's cards still draw the defaults (§14.2).

### 7. Borders look worse on the board than in hand — find out and fix
- Likely cause: on the board minion layout the panel covers the face's edge, so `cards/cosmetics.css` draws the border as a flat inset rim, `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.2cqmin var(--trim-2)`, one solid colour on top of the dark inner shadow, instead of the hand face's `--cf-edge` gradient/pattern (wood grain, circuit lines). Confirm with screenshots of each border (Wood, Bone, Circuit) in hand and on the board (`ui-walkthrough` skill), then draw the board's border with the same edge treatment so a border looks like the same object in both places. Before/after screenshots go in the pull request.

### 8. Global cosmetics are Epic+ and drop from card packs on a global roll (an economy rule change)
- **Account cosmetics are Epic or better.** Playmats (`table`), backdrops (`field`) and card backs (`cardBack`) other than each kind's default/starter become Epic, Legendary or Mythic in `crates/server/cosmetics.json`. Today `table-wood`, `field-embers`, `card-back-lacquer` are Common and `table-felt`, `field-rain`, `card-back-starfield` Rare: re-rate them (Epic, or a higher tier for the best of them) and keep every existing owner's ownership. The registry check (`crates/server/src/cosmetics.rs`) enforces the floor. §14.2 gets the rule; note a Rare cosmetic token then buys no account cosmetic (§14.5).
- **The global roll.** When a card pack slot's duplicate makes its cosmetic roll (§14.3's dupe chain), it first rolls `GLOBAL_COSMETIC_ROLL_WEIGHT` out of `TIER_WEIGHT_TOTAL` (10%): on a hit the slot grants an account cosmetic the account does not own instead of a per-card cosmetic for that card, its rarity a tiered roll on `COSMETIC_TIER_WEIGHTS` floored at Epic (`GLOBAL_COSMETIC_FLOOR_RARITY`), falling through tiers as the cosmetic pack slots do (R1306001); if no account cosmetic is left unowned, it rolls the per-card cosmetic as today. New constants in `crates/server/src/config.rs`, exported to `serverConfig.ts`; the roll is seeded and logged like every other (§14.11); a server test proves the rate over a seeded run and that nothing below Epic drops. Publish the new line on the Purchases page's odds (§2).
- **Owner's call if the reading is wrong:** this takes "on top of the card" as *in place of the duplicate's per-card cosmetic*, so pity, a new card's unlock and the bars are untouched. If the owner meant every slot (new cards too) gets an extra 10% chance at a global cosmetic in addition to the card, the builder asks on this issue before building §8.
- **Per-card stays per-card.** Finishes, borders, full-art faces and foils stay tied to one card (already §14.2); nothing here makes them global.

## Acceptance
- Jlore pill: a web test renders it from a wallet answer, re-renders on a bought pack's answer, links to `/shop`, and is absent signed out and on the board.
- Pity and odds: `/shop` and the pack screen no longer render the counters or the odds table (tests updated, R1339000/R1580000 superseded by new notes); the Purchases page renders both from the server's answers, and the footer and `/shop` link to it.
- Bars: a component test drives a token bar from before → after an opening (including an overflow pay) and an XP track from before → after a game with a level-up, asserting the reward reveal shows the server's rewards; reduced motion skips the animation and shows the end state.
- Per-card cosmetics: picks are stored per card, a card wears its own picks in game and in the inspect preview, an unowned cosmetic can't be equipped outside practice/hotseat, and an opponent's cards draw the defaults (tests in `cards/cosmetics.test.tsx`, `game/cosmetics.test.tsx`, `collection/collection.test.tsx`).
- Borders: before/after screenshots in the pull request; the board minion border uses the face's edge treatment.
- Global roll: registry check refuses a non-default account cosmetic below Epic; a server test shows the global roll's rate and floor; `spec/14-economy.md` §14.2/§14.3/§14.4 edited, rulings written, `cargo jackioh spec check` green.
- All five required checks green, `apps/web/src/wire/` regenerated and committed.

## Notes for the split
Vertical slices that touch different files fit fullsend: (a) Jlore pill + nav; (b) Purchases page + moving pity/odds; (c) the shared fill-bar component + token bars + Chase Shard; (d) XP track fills and level-up rewards (may need a server answer change), reads (c)'s component; (e) store packs as physical objects + opening scene; (f) per-card cosmetics store + Collection in-context previews + inspect preview; (g) board border fix; (h) the server's global roll, registry re-rate and spec/rulings. Only (d) is blocked by (c); (f) and (h) both touch the cosmetics registry's readers, so keep the registry file in (h) alone.
```
